title: An exit code calculator
description:
Work a value out in registers and return it as the exit code.

```
(no output)
exit code: 42
```

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .text
_start:
        mov     ebx, 20
        mov     ecx, 1
        ; TODO: rdi = 2 * (rbx + rcx), with mov and add only

        mov     eax, 60
        syscall

hints: `add rbx, rcx` gives 21 in `rbx`; adding a register to itself (`add rbx, rbx`) doubles it (lesson 1.03).
`print_int` may change `rcx` and `rdi`, so print after the sum is in `rbx` and copy it into `rdi` again before the exit call.
requirements: Start with 20 in `rbx` and 1 in `rcx`, and compute `2 × (rbx + rcx)` using only `mov` and `add`, ending in `rdi` for the exit call.
Show the result with `print_int` before exiting, too.
stretch: In a terminal, run the program and check the code with `echo $?`.
